scope: Column loading sensitivity: 1 pF per column, explicitly assumed fixture load, not measured board capacitance or qualified model
changedStatement: Add 1 pF column-to-ground fixture capacitance on each column
interpretation: The unchanged full-precision output stimulus completes at 104 us after adding 1 pF from each column to ground. This reveals load sensitivity of the formerly capacitance-free column boundary. The value is an explicit fixture assumption, not measured parasitics; replay success does not establish live-board execution, rail levels, timestep convergence or firmware qualification.
